name: SSSPlayer
description: Music and video player for PS Vita by SergioSSantiago. Browse ux0 and uma0, play audio with screen off, precise video seek, YouTube play/download, network streaming, and in-app update check.
long_description:
SSSPlayer is an all-in-one media player for PlayStation Vita by SergioSSantiago.

Why it exists:
- Access media on multiple memory mounts (ux0: and uma0:)
- Play both music and video with scrub-to-the-second seek
- Keep music playing with the screen off
- Search, watch, and download YouTube (video ~360p or audio-only M4A)

Music:
- Browse ux0:/music and uma0:/music (MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A/AAC)
- Now Playing with touch scrub on the progress bar
- 10-band equalizer, spectrum visualizer, M3U playlists
- Theme system (Terminus CRT theme by default)

Video:
- Browse ux0:/video, uma0:/video, ux0:/movies, uma0:/movies
- Hardware H.264 playback with exact seek / scrub
- Subtitles and audio tracks
- Network sources: SMB, SFTP, WebDAV, Jellyfin

YouTube:
- Search and stream on-device (~360p progressive H.264)
- Download video or audio (M4A)

Tips:
- Exit from Settings → Exit SSSPlayer (Home is disabled to avoid a bad suspend)
- Check for updates in-app; the VPK lands on ux0: — install it with VitaShell

Install:
1. Download SSSPlayer-x.y.z.vpk from GitHub Releases
2. Enable FTP in VitaShell
3. Copy the VPK to ux0: with Cyberduck
4. Install from VitaShell

Credits: built by SergioSSantiago. Thanks to VitaWave and VitaMediaDeck — SSSPlayer reuses foundations from both projects.
